Directed topology diagnostics found no path among 66559-, 57411-, and 85465-. No threshold, anchor length, or rescue rule was altered. No BGCPhaser candidate score, truth rank, chemistry score, or reference-similarity outcome was inspected. A diagnostic helper initially queried column `oriented_path` although the chunk table uses `oriented_walk`; that diagnostic-only mismatch did not affect the G5 result.

notes: Prospective screening stopped at G2 before any run was locked or reads downloaded. MIBiG locus completeness does not satisfy the frozen G2 requirement for finished sequence-level truth. Four same-sample WGS/GENOMIC/RANDOM/PAIRED/ILLUMINA runs (SRR034553, SRR034554, SRR065633, SRR139156) were identified, but no run-selection tie was adjudicated after G2 failure. No download, assembly, G5 localization, candidate enumeration, score, truth rank, chemistry outcome, or reference-similarity outcome was inspected.
